# Web/Wasm fixtures

`test/web/web_fixtures.dart` embeds every `.parquet` file in this directory as
base64, so the browser/Wasm suites are self-contained and need no `dart:io`.
Regenerate the embedded map after changing a fixture:

```sh
python test/fixtures/web/generate_fixtures.py
```

## Generated fixtures (MIT, this repository)

Generated by `generate_fixtures.py` with pyarrow 26.0.0:

- flat codec/encoding matrix (`flat_*.parquet`), nested `nested*.parquet`,
  `multi_rowgroup`, `page_index`
- v0.2 deep nesting: `deep_list_list`, `deep_list_struct`,
  `deep_struct_children`, `deep_map_children`

These are written with pyarrow's default compliant nested layout, PLAIN encoding
and data page v1 unless the file name says otherwise.
